name: Toss To Trash
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: TOP_G2026
description: TossToTrash is a server-side Fabric mod that eliminates entity lag by replacing dropped items with a virtual disposal bin. Players simply use the /trash command to open a UI where items are permanently deleted upon closing.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln 0.4.8 (17 classes, 21 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
